exact_statement: For the actual Boolean prime mask56067 positive on {a=b=z=1}, {a=0,c=z=1}, or {b=c=0}, under every independent interior Bernoulli input law, corrected entropy in bits satisfies Hplus<=(2+6/ln2)(I-Var). In reflected coordinates (a,x,y,z)=(a,1-b,1-c,z) of probabilities (alpha,e,d,q), let u=4alpha(1-alpha),vx=4e(1-e),vy=4d(1-d),w=4q(1-q),Tx=u*vx*w/16,Ty=u*vy*w/16,T=Tx+Ty, and E=(ln2)Hplus. Its exact higher-degree entropy is E_ge2=ln4*Delta+G, where Delta=I-Var, G=2T*A(q)+2Tx*A(alpha)+2Ty*A(1-alpha)+(uw/4)h(d-e), A(t)=t ln(1/t)/(1-t), h(t)=t^2 ln(1/t^2); G<=6T and E_single<=4Delta-2T, proving E<=(6+ln4)Delta. The same constant bounds ordinary uniform entropy H/I and transfers by genuine disjoint composition when every gate has that corrected bound at its actual induced laws. The all-bias corrected supremum for this prime lies between 2+4/ln2 and 2+6/ln2; the lower endpoint is realized as a limit of the actual joint path (alpha,e,d,q)=(1-t^2,t^6,t^8,1-t). A proposed sufficient polynomial strengthening S_poly>=4T, S_poly=sum_i vi[2(di-|ci|)+|ci|(1-|ci|)^2], is false at (alpha,e,d,q)=(1/2,1/1024,1/1048576,1/16), with exact gap -16029490109593689663/302231454903657293676544. This refutes only that surrogate; no sharp all-bias upper bound or universal FEI claim is asserted.

exact_statement: For the Boolean prime mask56067, positive on {a=b=z=1}, {a=0,c=z=1} or {b=c=0}, write alpha=P(a=1),q=P(z=1),e=P(b=0),d=P(c=0), with alpha,q fixed interior and e,d independently tending to zero. Its exact combined normalized coefficients are (2) and its exact corrected natural entropy and deficit are (3)-(4) of PROOF.md. Writing Le=4alpha q(2-alpha-q),Ld=4(1-alpha)q(1+alpha-q), theta=Le e/(Le e+Ld d), delta=max(e,d), R(alpha,q)=ln4+2[(1-q)+q ln(1/q)+alpha ln(1/alpha)]/(2-alpha-q), one has Hplus/(I-Var)=[theta R(alpha,q)+(1-theta)R(1-alpha,q)]/ln2+O_alpha,q(delta ln(1/delta)), uniform over relative e,d rates and uniformly on compact interior alpha,q domains. Each fixed-interior R is strictly below 4+ln4; the supremum of all such face tangent ratios is 2+4/ln2 in bits. Thus the Cstar corrected inequality holds in a sufficiently small entire e,d collar for each fixed alpha,q, uniformly on compact interior parameter sets. The actual joint path (p_a,p_b,p_c,p_z)=(1-t^2,1-t^6,1-t^8,1-t) has I-Var=4t^7+O(t^8), E=(16+8ln2)t^7+O(t^8 ln(1/t)), and ratio tending to 2+4/ln2. At the contracted literal face E=I-Var=0; no endpoint quotient is assigned. No general four-bias upper bound or universal FEI theorem is asserted.
